lines: Alrighhht, this is the spicy part. You can adjust the appearance of LRCPlus to your liking. I prefer Sakura ngl.\nw6
Pick whichever feels more like you.\nw3
You can always change your theme later in Settings~\e

readingpreferences.speaker: Setup Wizard
lines: Lyrics, Romaji, Translation, and Furigana are separate layers. Check the ones you want and drag them into your preferred order.\nw4

Furigana stays attached to words: put it before Lyrics for above, or after Lyrics for below. Romaji is smaller beside Lyrics and full-size on its own. Translation uses translated lines saved in the lyric file. Keep at least one layer checked.\nw4
Try the sample below. Apply and Next saves your defaults; Do this later keeps your current settings. Floating Lyrics follows these preferences too.\e

fourthsteplyrics.speaker: Setup Wizard
lines: LRCPlus can display lyrics from your own files, or help you search for them online.\nw3
Okay, so... you wanna search for lyrics online?\button(Yes,lyrics_online)\button(No,ok)
\c6You can reorder and toggle lyric layers in Settings > Lyrics > Readings.\e
